description: OurAirports publishes a nightly open data dump of the airports in its crowd-maintained database: airports.csv (identifiers, ICAO and IATA codes, type from heliport to large airport, coordinates, elevation, municipality, scheduled service), runways.csv (length, width, surface, lighting and threshold coordinates per runway end), airport-frequencies.csv, navaids.csv (worldwide radio navigation aids), countries.csv, regions.csv and member comments. It is a volunteer site started in 2007 whose registered users add and correct airports; the site counted 86,135 airports on 26 September 2026. Coverage is worldwide, including small airstrips, heliports, seaplane bases and closed airfields, at the level of individual facilities and runway ends. Files are UTF-8 CSV, also offered as HXL and per-region downloads, regenerated every night and stored since November 2021 in the GitHub repository davidmegginson/ourairports-data. All data is released to the public domain, free, with credit requested but not required. Caveats: the site states the data comes with no guarantee of accuracy or fitness for use, contributions are not officially verified, and rarely changing files keep old dates on GitHub. OurAirports is a standard source of airport nodes and runway attributes for air network flow, capacity and hazard-exposure studies, and supplies the curated airport table used by OpenFlights, catalogued here.
